title: Otori Emu — Wonderlands×Showtime〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, are you trying to give me a heart attack? What are you doing here anyway?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! I dropped in to see you♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You can't just sneak into people's schools whenever you want to see them! So, what do you want?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Look, I brought you these!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Seriously, you dumped a pile of photos on my desk?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hold on... Are these from our shows?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, the mascots took them!
They're pretty good, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Point out ONE that's good!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What do you mean? You don't like them?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No! None of them shows ME being awesome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm out of the frame in every picture. They're all focused on you...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But look at this one!
They caught you mid-blink. You look so dopey, haha♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Are you even listening?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I am! But why are you so angry?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because there are no good pictures here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That's not true! They're very good, every one of them! Look at this one for example!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Robo-Nene's doing her razzle dazzle thing!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And this picture's so aaah but also yee-haw whoa hoy hoy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sigh...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't understand what aaah yee-haw whoa hoy hoy is supposed to mean...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But this is a decent photo, I give you that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Told you!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Your park mascots know how to capture photogenic moments.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Urgh, what am I saying!?
They didn't photograph me at all!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Found it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're ignoring me again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See this girl? She looks familiar, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Where? You mean this blurry person in the audience?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! Lately, she's been coming to our shows every week!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... Was there someone like that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How can you not remember the hammie girl who's always sitting in the same seat?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hammie? What is that?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You really don't know what I'm talking about? Her cheeks go poof-poof like this!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Her cheeks...go poof-poof?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! It's totally poof-poof but, at the end, she always explodes into a smile♪

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry, I have no idea who that is.
But...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If she's showing up every week, she could be our most devoted fan.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's big news, right?
I've got to tell Nene and Rui!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'll go show them the photos!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Wait up, Emu! You forgot some!
Come back and pick them all up, you hear?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Neneee♪ Ruiii♪
